mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_member (username, password, email, birth_year) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{birthYear})
mapper.select: SELECT no, username, password, email, birth_year as birthYear, reg_date as regDate, updated_date as updatedDate FROM tbl_member ORDER BY no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_member SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, birth_year = #{birthYear}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE no = #{no}
